God knows how they treat dine-in customers if this is their online service quality.

featured_reviews.name: Chef Vaidehi Pathare
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Burger King outlet is located just a 5-minute walk from Kandarpada metro station, which makes it very convenient to reach whether you are on your way home from work, meeting friends, or simply visiting the area. I have visited this outlet quite a few times and always opted for the dine-in option, though takeaway is also available for those who prefer it.

The outlet is quite spacious for a fast-food chain, with neatly arranged seating that is comfortable enough to sit and enjoy a meal without feeling cramped. The air conditioning is adequate, and the décor has a clean, simple, and modern look that feels pleasant and inviting. It is a good place to come with friends or family, and the overall atmosphere is relaxed. Tables are usually clean here. It does get crowded during peak hours, especially in the late evenings.

The service has been consistently good on my visits, with orders being served promptly. The food quality is decent and matches the standard expected from Burger King. I particularly enjoy their French Fries and Chicken Whopper Burger, which have always been fresh and consistent in taste on each visit.

Ratings:
Quality - 3.7/5
Quantity - 4/5
Service - 3.5/5
Price – ₹400 for 2 people

featured_reviews.name: Ronit Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular customer of The Wadapav Cafe, and I can say these guys make one of the best Wada pav's.

Coming to the order, we had ordered a few Wada Pav's (regular ones) and two peri-peri fries. The Wada pav was superb. The Wada was prepared in fresh oil and were perfectly crisp, and the potato stuffing had a pretty good taste. The best part was the Wada weren't too spicy and were tasting perfect. Also, there was not a single mark where we could see that the Wada was over-friend, meaning these guys do make sure that the items they serve are perfect for consumption.

The peri-peri fries were terrific too. They were perfectly golden and crisp, and the plenty of masalas they added did make it taste spicy. The best part of the fries was the quantity was very good and enough for a single person. Even in fries, not even a single of it had turned black, which again indicated they took great care to ensure the fries were fried only as much as needed.

Lastly, the dry chutney that they sent with the Wada Pav was delicious and complemented the Wada Pav perfectly for those who wanted to add that extra spice. All in all, the food is delicious, and with the quantity and quality, it is truly a value for money.
